subject: Request: Trial extension & credits due to SAML/ingest backlog
messages:
From: Sara Patel <sara.patel@greengrid.ai>
To: olga_petrov@redwood.com
Date: 2027-04-19T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Trial kickoff - urgent: SAML mismatch + ingestion backlog - ask for runway

Hi Olga,

Thanks again for the walkthrough last week. We're excited to push Redwood into our ingestion pipeline, but we've run into two blockers that are preventing us from reaching demo-ready: 

- SAML assertion mapping: our corporate Okta config is returning an unexpected attribute set for the Redwood SSO integration. We've attached a small trace file that shows the assertion for a failing user.
- Upstream ingestion queue: our data engineering team uncovered a schema mismatch in the CSV/JSON transformer that will take at least 2 full sprints to resolve.

Both issues mean we can't complete the integration tests and therefore won't hit the agreed demo window on 4/26. Given this, can Redwood extend the trial by 30 days and provide a small sandbox credit (tokens) so we can continue experimenting once the transformers are updated? We appreciate any runway you can provide — the internal sponsor is ready to move once we have a green build.

Attachments: greengrid_saml_trace.txt (plain text)

Thanks,
Sara Patel
Head of Data Integrations
GreenGrid, Inc.
---
Phone: +1-415-555-0133

From: olga_petrov@redwood.com
To: Sara Patel <sara.patel@greengrid.ai>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2027-04-19T11:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Trial kickoff - urgent: SAML mismatch + ingestion backlog - ask for runway

Sara —

Really sorry to hear you hit both of these at once. Thanks for the trace — that helps. I've looped in Karthik (engineering) and Marissa (customer success) so we can triage quickly. A few quick items so we can move faster: 

1) Karthik can review the SAML trace. If it's an attribute mapping we can usually provide a short mapping shim while your Okta team adjusts.
2) Marissa will coordinate access to a persistent sandbox and outline what a 30-day extension + credit would look like from our side.

We typically approve 30-day runway extensions for integration-blocker cases and can front-load a $10k sandbox credit (tokens) for customers in your stage, pending a quick approval from Sales Ops. Ben in Sales Ops will need to sign off; I'll put together the recommended note.

I'll follow up with an internal note and get back with a concrete answer within 24 business hours. 

Best,
Olga Petrov
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
olga_petrov@redwood.com | +1-650-555-0199

From: olga_petrov@redwood.com
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: 2027-04-20T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: FW: GreenGrid - trial extension/credits request (SAML + ingest backlog)

Karthik / Marissa —

Forwarding Sara's note and trace. TL;DR: integration blocked by SAML attribute mapping (Okta) and a separate ingestion transformer mismatch delaying demo. Ask: 30-day trial extension + $10k sandbox credit to avoid losing momentum. Internal sponsor committed; this is a Stage 2 POC (deal GD-4821).

Karthik: could you confirm whether we can ship a short attribute mapping shim or a config workaround in the next 48 hours? If it's a simple assertion rename we can provide a patch that the customer applies to their IdP.

Marissa: if Sales Ops approves, please prepare the extension email and a short MOU we can attach (I drafted a one-paragraph addendum below).

Ben (cc): can you approve $10k in sandbox credit for GD-4821? If you need it split (e.g., token credit vs. service credit) say so.

Proposed MOU language (draft): 
"Redwood will provide a 30-day trial extension to GreenGrid, including a $10,000 sandbox credit valid for the extended period. This credit is non-refundable and applies only to sandbox/PoC usage for the stated account."

Thanks — please reply with approvals or edits.

— Olga

From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: olga_petrov@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2027-04-20T16:43:00-07:00
Subject: Re: FW: GreenGrid - trial extension/credits request (SAML + ingest backlog)

Approved.

Give them the 30-day extension and $10k sandbox credit. Split is fine: $8k token credit, $2k service credit (applied if they request engineering hours). Ask CS to track usage and confirm milestone — if they progress to demo by end of extension we can consider an additional credit as a one-time goodwill.

Also, Karthik: tag me on the change if you ship a one-off shim so Legal knows it's a short-term workaround and not a product change.

Ben Carter
Head of Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

From: olga_petrov@redwood.com

Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2027-04-21T16:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Trial kickoff - urgent: SAML mismatch + ingestion backlog - ask for runway

Sara —

Good news: we can absolutely extend your trial. Redwood will provide the following: 

- 30-day trial extension starting today (new demo window moved to 5/21).
- $10,000 sandbox credit applied to your account (split: $8,000 token credit + $2,000 service credit available for engineering assistance).
- Karthik will review the attached SAML trace and propose a short attribute-mapping shim within 48 hours.

Next steps: 
1) Please confirm you accept the addendum (attached MOU draft — GreenGrid_MOU_draft.pdf). If okay, I will route the DocuSign link for signature.
2) Marissa will open a CS ticket and schedule a 30-minute sync with your engineering lead and Karthik to scope the shim and ingestion fix priorities.
